name: Tanikaze Haruka
source:
Hobbies: Cooking (she's pretty good at this), fashion.
Likes: Cute and pretty things.
Dislikes: Shaggy hair, insects (especially those who have many legs).

Haruka is very proud to be the leader of her school's fashion gang. She is a festival lover and her class's moodmaker. When she gets excited, she likes to hug just about anybody she sees. Haruka is often late to class because it takes her extra time to set her hair every morning. [spoiler](because in reality she has straight hair.)[/spoiler] Because she lives in [url=/c12036]Akira[/url]'s neighborhood, they often meet each other at mornings. In order to get along with Akira, Haruka does makeovers to her, brushes her hair and fixes her appearance. It should be noted that her breasts are obviously catching Akira's eye.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=769298]Getchu[/url]]
